SELECT 
  fullVisitorId,
  date,
  visitNumber,
  visitId,
  visitStartTime,
  totals.transactions,
  device.deviceCategory,
  h.hitNumber,
  h.type,
  h.transaction.transactionId,
  h.transaction.transactionRevenue,
  h.time
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
UNNEST(hits) AS h
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
  AND h.type = 'TRANSACTION'
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  MAX(week_sum) as max_weekly
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(daily_rev) as week_sum
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      date,
      SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000 as daily_rev
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) as hit,
    UNNEST(hit.product) as p
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
      AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
      AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY date
  )
  GROUP BY 
    FLOOR((CASE 
      WHEN SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '01' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
      WHEN SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '02' THEN 31 + CAST(SUBSTR(date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
      WHEN SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '03' THEN 59 + CAST(SUBSTR(date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
      WHEN SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '04' THEN 90 + CAST(SUBSTR(date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
      WHEN SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '05' THEN 120 + CAST(SUBSTR(date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
      WHEN SUBSTR(date, 5, 2) = '06' THEN 151 + CAST(SUBSTR(date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
    END - 1) / 7.0)
)

WITH session_product AS (
  SELECT 
    t.fullVisitorId,
    t.visitId,
    t.totals.transactions,
    t.totals.pageviews,
    t.date,
    MAX(hp.productRevenue) as max_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS hp
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
  GROUP BY t.fullVisitorId, t.visitId, t.totals.transactions, t.totals.pageviews, t.date
),
session_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    transactions,
    pageviews,
    date,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND max_product_revenue IS NOT NULL THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND max_product_revenue IS NULL THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as session_type
  FROM session_product
)
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
  session_type,
  ROUND(AVG(pageviews), 2) as avg_pageviews
FROM session_classified
WHERE session_type IN ('purchase', 'non-purchase')
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type

WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, UNNEST(hits) AS h, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductCategory = 'Home/Shop by Brand/YouTube/'
),
visitor_products AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, p.productQuantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, UNNEST(hits) AS h, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM youtube_buyers)
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
)
SELECT v2ProductName, SUM(productQuantity) as total_quantity
FROM visitor_products
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_incidents.incidents_2016`
  WHERE descript = 'PUBLIC INTOXICATION'
  GROUP BY date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(daily_count) as mean_count,
    STDDEV(daily_count) as stddev_count
  FROM daily_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.date,
    dc.daily_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) as z_score,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) DESC) as rnk
  FROM daily_counts dc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT date, daily_count, z_score, rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 2

WITH pageviews AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitNumber, visitId, hits.hitNumber, hits.time, hits.page.pagePath,
         LEAD(hits.page.pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hits.hitNumber) as next_page,
         LEAD(hits.time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hits.hitNumber) as next_time
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as hits
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
    AND trafficSource.campaign = 'Data Share Promo'
    AND hits.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM pageviews
  WHERE pagePath LIKE '/home%'
),
next_page_counts AS (
  SELECT next_page, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE next_page IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY next_page
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC) = 1
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT CAST(FLOOR(MAX((next_time - time) / 1000)) AS INT64) as max_time_seconds
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE next_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT np.next_page, mt.max_time_seconds
FROM next_page_counts np
CROSS JOIN max_time mt

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as monthly_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  MAX(monthly_rev) as highest_monthly_rev,
  MIN(monthly_rev) as lowest_monthly_rev,
  ROUND((MAX(monthly_rev) - MIN(monthly_rev)) / 1000000.0, 2) as diff_in_millions
FROM monthly_revenue

-- Find the top-selling product by quantity among customers who bought YouTube Men's Vintage Henley in July 2017
WITH customers_with_henley AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
),
customer_purchases AS (
  SELECT 
    c.fullVisitorId,
    p.v2ProductName,
    p.productQuantity
  FROM customers_with_henley c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
    ON c.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE s._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
)
SELECT 
  v2ProductName,
  SUM(productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM customer_purchases
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH engagement_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
),
engagement_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count_distinct_pseudo_users
FROM engagement_7day e7
WHERE e7.user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM engagement_2day)

WITH daily_data AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0 
    AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-04-30'
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) AS mm_dd
FROM daily_data
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT provider_city,
       SUM(total_discharges) AS total_discharges,
       SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY total_discharges DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Among the routes where bike is faster than taxi, find the one with the LONGEST average bike duration.
-- That would be the first one ordered by avg_bike_duration DESC.
-- The top result is: 12 Ave & W 40 St -> West St & Chambers St with avg 1483.91 seconds

-- But wait, let me reconsider. The question asks for "the longest average bike duration" among routes faster than yellow taxis.
-- Let me re-read: "which route is faster than yellow taxis and among those, which one has the longest average bike duration?"
-- So we want the route with the LONGEST bike duration that is still faster than the taxi on that route.

-- The answer appears to be: 12 Ave & W 40 St -> West St & Chambers St
-- The start station name is: 12 Ave & W 40 St

-- Let me verify by getting the exact result
WITH top_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_name,
        end_station_name,
        ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
        COUNT(*) as trip_count,
        AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE starttime >= '2016-01-01' AND starttime < '2017-01-01'
        AND tripduration > 0
    GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude
    ORDER BY trip_count DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
taxi_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
        AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01' AND pickup_datetime < '2017-01-01'
        AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL 
        AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
        AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
    GROUP BY start_lat, start_lon, end_lat, end_lon
)
SELECT 
    tr.start_station_name,
    tr.end_station_name,
    ROUND(tr.avg_bike_duration, 2) as avg_bike_duration
FROM top_routes tr
INNER JOIN taxi_avg ta 
    ON tr.start_lat = ta.start_lat 
    AND tr.start_lon = ta.start_lon
    AND tr.end_lat = ta.end_lat
    AND tr.end_lon = ta.end_lon
WHERE tr.avg_bike_duration < ta.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY tr.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT
    trip_seconds,
    SAFE_CAST(trip_seconds AS FLOAT64) / 60.0 AS trip_minutes,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
    AND fare IS NOT NULL
),
with_quantile AS (
  SELECT
    trip_seconds,
    trip_minutes,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) AS quantile_group
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT
  quantile_group,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  ROUND(MIN(trip_minutes)) AS min_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(trip_minutes)) AS max_duration_minutes,
  AVG(fare) AS avg_fare
FROM with_quantile
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

WITH fec_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        LEFT(zip_code, 5) as zip5,
        COUNT(*) as num_donations,
        SUM(transaction_amt) as total_amt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20`
    WHERE state = 'NY'
        AND zip_code IS NOT NULL
        AND zip_code != ''
    GROUP BY LEFT(zip_code, 5)
),
tract_zips AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        cw.census_tract_geoid,
        cw.zip_code
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` cw
    WHERE cw.census_tract_geoid LIKE '36047%'
),
tract_donations AS (
    SELECT 
        tz.census_tract_geoid,
        SUM(f.num_donations) as num_donations,
        SUM(f.total_amt) as total_amt
    FROM tract_zips tz
    INNER JOIN fec_agg f ON tz.zip_code = f.zip5
    GROUP BY tz.census_tract_geoid
)
SELECT 
    ct.geo_id as census_tract,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(td.total_amt, td.num_donations), 2) as avg_donation_amount,
    ct.median_income
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` ct
LEFT JOIN tract_donations td ON ct.geo_id = td.census_tract_geoid
WHERE ct.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
ORDER BY ct.geo_id

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted) AS total_subplot_acres,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0)) AS total_macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number 
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year 
    AND c.state_code = p.state_code
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
    AND p.evaluation_group_description LIKE '%2012%'
    AND c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP'
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) AS rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT 
  evaluation_group_description AS evaluation_group,
  evaluation_type,
  CAST(condition_status_code AS STRING) AS condition_status_code,
  evaluation_description,
  CAST(state_code AS STRING) AS state_code,
  total_macroplot_acres AS macroplot_acres,
  total_subplot_acres AS subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  a.country_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.age < 20 THEN a.population ELSE 0 END) as pop_under_20,
  m.midyear_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.age < 20 THEN a.population ELSE 0 END), m.midyear_population) * 100, 2) as pct_under_20
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific` a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population` m
  ON a.country_code = m.country_code AND a.year = m.year
WHERE a.year = 2020
GROUP BY a.country_name, m.midyear_population
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  country_name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(cumulative_recovered AS FLOAT64), CAST(cumulative_confirmed AS FLOAT64)) * 100, 2) as recovery_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE date = '2020-05-10' 
  AND aggregation_level = 0 
  AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
  AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL
  AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed
ORDER BY recovery_rate DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    temp AS temp_f,
    prcp AS prcp_in,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp_knots
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290'
    AND year = '2019'
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
    AND temp != 9999.9
    AND prcp != 99.99
    AND wdsp != '999.9'
),
with_conversions AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    ROUND((temp_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp_in * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(wdsp_knots * 0.514444, 1) AS wdsp_ms
  FROM daily
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wdsp_ma8
  FROM with_conversions
),
with_lags AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    temp_ma8,
    prcp_ma8,
    wdsp_ma8,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_1,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_1,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_1,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_2,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_2,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_2,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_3,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_3,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_3,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_4,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_4,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_4,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_5,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_5,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_5,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_6,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_6,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_6,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_7,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_7,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_7,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_8,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_8,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_8
  FROM with_ma
)
SELECT
  date,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wdsp_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wdsp_ma8,
  temp_ma_diff_1,
  prcp_ma_diff_1,
  wdsp_ma_diff_1,
  temp_ma_diff_2,
  prcp_ma_diff_2,
  wdsp_ma_diff_2,
  temp_ma_diff_3,
  prcp_ma_diff_3,
  wdsp_ma_diff_3,
  temp_ma_diff_4,
  prcp_ma_diff_4,
  wdsp_ma_diff_4,
  temp_ma_diff_5,
  prcp_ma_diff_5,
  wdsp_ma_diff_5,
  temp_ma_diff_6,
  prcp_ma_diff_6,
  wdsp_ma_diff_6,
  temp_ma_diff_7,
  prcp_ma_diff_7,
  wdsp_ma_diff_7,
  temp_ma_diff_8,
  prcp_ma_diff_8,
  wdsp_ma_diff_8
FROM with_lags
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 15

-- Get the final latitude for the storm with the second longest distance
WITH storm_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    iso_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA'
),
consecutive_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    a.sid,
    a.name,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(a.longitude, a.latitude),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(b.longitude, b.latitude)
    ) as segment_distance
  FROM storm_tracks a
  JOIN storm_tracks b ON a.sid = b.sid AND a.rn = b.rn - 1
),
distance_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    SUM(segment_distance) as total_distance_meters,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(segment_distance) DESC) as dist_rank
  FROM consecutive_pairs
  GROUP BY sid, name
)
SELECT h.latitude as final_latitude
FROM distance_ranked d
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h ON d.sid = h.sid
WHERE d.dist_rank = 2
AND h.iso_time = (SELECT MAX(iso_time) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` WHERE sid = d.sid)

SELECT id, name, latitude, longitude
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations`
WHERE ST_DISTANCE(
  ST_GEOGPOINT(-87.6847, 41.8319),
  ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude)
) <= 50000

WITH trip_distances AS (
  SELECT
    t.bike_number,
    2 * 6371000 * ASIN(SQRT(

-- 4. Pearson correlation coefficient (rounded to 4 decimals) between temperature and daily complaint count
-- 5. Pearson correlation coefficient (rounded to 4 decimals) between temperature and daily percentage of total complaints
-- Filter: > 5000 total occurrences, |correlation| > 0.5, exclude invalid temp (9999.9)

WITH weather AS (
  SELECT 
    stn,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CONCAT(year, mo, da)) as date,
    temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860')
    AND temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2010' AND '2017'
),
temp_daily AS (
  SELECT date, AVG(temp) as temp_val
  FROM weather
  GROUP BY date
),
complaints AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, DATE(created_date) as complaint_date, COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE DATE(created_date) >= '2010-01-01' AND DATE(created_date) <= '2017-12-31'
  GROUP BY complaint_type, DATE(created_date)
),
complaint_total AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, SUM(daily_count) as total_count
  FROM complaints
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(daily_count) > 5000
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    c.complaint_type,
    td.temp_val,
    c.daily_count,
    ct.total_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.daily_count, ct.total_count) * 100 as pct_of_total
  FROM complaints c
  JOIN complaint_total ct ON c.complaint_type = ct.complaint_type
  JOIN temp_daily td ON c.complaint_date = td.date
),
corr AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    SUM(daily_count) as total_complaints,
    COUNT(*) as days_with_valid_temp,
    ROUND(
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(temp_val * daily_count) - SUM(temp_val) * SUM(daily_count)) 
      / SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(temp_val, 2)) - POWER(SUM(temp_val), 2)) 
             * (COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(daily_count, 2)) - POWER(SUM(daily_count), 2))),
      4
    ) as corr_temp_count,
    ROUND(
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(temp_val * pct_of_total) - SUM(temp_val) * SUM(pct_of_total)) 
      / SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(temp_val, 2)) - POWER(SUM(temp_val), 2)) 
             * (COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(pct_of_total, 2)) - POWER(SUM(pct_of_total), 2))),
      4
    ) as corr_temp_pct
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  total_complaints,
  days_with_valid_temp,
  corr_temp_count,
  corr_temp_pct
FROM corr
WHERE ABS(corr_temp_count) > 0.5
ORDER BY ABS(corr_temp_count) DESC

  SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) as total_count

  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 3000
),

    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Poor', 'Fair', 'Shaft', 'Critical') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Dead', 'Stump') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != '' AND spc_latin NOT IN ('PLANTING SITE', 'UNKNOWN LIVE TREES', 'UNKNOWN DEAD TREES', 'UNKNOWN STUMP', 'STUMP')
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
c2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as latin_name,
    COUNT(*) as total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Dead', 'Stump') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(a.latin_name, b.latin_name) as latin_name,
    COALESCE(a.total_count, 0) as total_1995,
    COALESCE(b.total_count, 0) as total_2015,
    COALESCE(a.alive_count, 0) as alive_1995,
    COALESCE(b.alive_count, 0) as alive_2015,
    COALESCE(a.dead_count, 0) as dead_1995,
    COALESCE(b.dead_count, 0) as dead_2015,
    COALESCE(b.total_count, 0) - COALESCE(a.total_count, 0) as total_growth,
    COALESCE(b.alive_count, 0) - COALESCE(a.alive_count, 0) as alive_growth,
    COALESCE(b.dead_count, 0) - COALESCE(a.dead_count, 0) as dead_growth
  FROM c1995 a
  FULL OUTER JOIN c2015 b ON a.latin_name = b.latin_name
)
SELECT 
  c.latin_name,
  ts.species_common_name as common_name,
  c.total_1995,
  c.total_2015,
  c.alive_1995,
  c.alive_2015,
  c.dead_1995,
  c.dead_2015,
  c.total_growth,
  c.alive_growth,
  c.dead_growth
FROM combined c
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species` ts 
  ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = c.latin_name
ORDER BY c.total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH target_zips AS (

    FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
    WHERE state_code = 'WA'
    AND ST_DISTANCE(
        internal_point_geom,
        ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833)
    ) < 5 * 1609.344
),
tract_zip_overlaps AS (
    SELECT 
        t.geo_id,
        z.zip_code,
        ST_Area(ST_Intersection(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) AS overlap_area,
        ST_Area(t.tract_geom) AS tract_area
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` t
    JOIN target_zips z
      ON ST_Intersects(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
    WHERE ST_Area(ST_Intersection(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) > 0
),
tract_data AS (
    SELECT geo_id, total_pop, income_per_capita
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr`
),
allocated AS (
    SELECT 
        o.zip_code,
        o.geo_id,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(o.overlap_area, o.tract_area) AS alloc_ratio,
        td.total_pop,
        td.income_per_capita,
        td.total_pop * SAFE_DIVIDE(o.overlap_area, o.tract_area) AS allocated_pop,
        td.income_per_capita * td.total_pop * SAFE_DIVIDE(o.overlap_area, o.tract_area) AS allocated_income
    FROM tract_zip_overlaps o
    JOIN tract_data td ON o.geo_id = td.geo_id
    WHERE td.total_pop > 0
)
SELECT 
    zip_code,
    ROUND(SUM(allocated_pop), 1) AS total_population,
    ROUND(SUM(allocated_income) / SUM(allocated_pop), 1) AS avg_individual_income
FROM allocated

WITH natality AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) AS birth_year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS AS county_fips,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) AS no_morbidity_births,
    SUM(Births) AS total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE Year IN (DATE('2016-01-01'), DATE('2017-01-01'), DATE('2018-01-01'))
    AND Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
  GROUP BY birth_year, county_fips
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    n.birth_year,
    CASE n.birth_year
      WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate
      WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate
      WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate
    END AS poverty_rate,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(n.no_morbidity_births, n.total_births) * 100 AS no_morbidity_pct
  FROM natality n
  LEFT JOIN census_2015 c2015 ON n.county_fips = c2015.geo_id AND n.birth_year = 2016
  LEFT JOIN census_2016 c2016 ON n.county_fips = c2016.geo_id AND n.birth_year = 2017
  LEFT JOIN census_2017 c2017 ON n.county_fips = c2017.geo_id AND n.birth_year = 2018
  WHERE n.total_births > 0
    AND (CASE n.birth_year
      WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
    END)
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    birth_year,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) AS sum_x,
    SUM(no_morbidity_pct) AS sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * no_morbidity_pct) AS sum_xy,
    SUM(POWER(poverty_rate, 2)) AS sum_x2,
    SUM(POWER(no_morbidity_pct, 2)) AS sum_y2
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY birth_year
)
SELECT 
  birth_year,
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - POWER(sum_x, 2)) * (n * sum_y2 - POWER(sum_y, 2)))
    ),
    6
  ) AS pearson_correlation
FROM stats
ORDER BY birth_year

WITH latest_eg AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        MAX(evaluation_group) as latest_eg
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
    WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    GROUP BY state_code
),
filtered_pop AS (
    SELECT 
        p.plot_sequence_number,
        p.state_code,
        p.expansion_factor,
        p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
        p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    JOIN latest_eg le ON p.state_code = le.state_code AND p.evaluation_group = le.latest_eg
    WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
condition_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        c.plot_sequence_number,
        c.state_code,
        c.condition_status_code,
        c.reserved_status_code,
        c.site_productivity_class_code,
        c.proportion_basis,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN 
                fp.expansion_factor * c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted * 
                    CASE WHEN fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot ELSE 1 END
            WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN 
                fp.expansion_factor * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted *
                    CASE WHEN fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot ELSE 1 END
            ELSE 0
        END as acres
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
    JOIN filtered_pop fp ON c.plot_sequence_number = fp.plot_sequence_number AND c.state_code = fp.state_code
),
state_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 AND reserved_status_code = 0 AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN acres ELSE 0 END) as timberland_acres,
        SUM(CASE WHEN condition_status_code = 1 THEN acres ELSE 0 END) as forestland_acres
    FROM condition_acres
    GROUP BY state_code
),
timberland_max AS (
    SELECT state_code FROM state_totals ORDER BY timberland_acres DESC LIMIT 1
),
forestland_max AS (
    SELECT state_code FROM state_totals ORDER BY forestland_acres DESC LIMIT 1
),
state_names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT state_code, state_code_name
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition`
)
SELECT 
    'timberland' as category,
    tm.state_code,
    le_latest.latest_eg as evaluation_group,
    sn.state_code_name,
    st.timberland_acres as total_acres
FROM timberland_max tm
JOIN latest_eg le_latest ON tm.state_code = le_latest.state_code
JOIN state_totals st ON tm.state_code = st.state_code
JOIN state_names sn ON tm.state_code = sn.state_code

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'forestland' as category,
    fm.state_code,
    le_latest.latest_eg as evaluation_group,
    sn.state_code_name,
    st.forestland_acres as total_acres
FROM forestland_max fm
JOIN latest_eg le_latest ON fm.state_code = le_latest.state_code
JOIN state_totals st ON fm.state_code = st.state_code
JOIN state_names sn ON fm.state_code = sn.state_code

WITH variants AS (
  SELECT 
    reference_name,
    start_position,
    end_position,
    AN,
    alternate_bases
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1`
  WHERE reference_name = 'chr1'
    AND start_position >= 55039447
    AND end_position <= 55064852
),
gene_symbols AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT v.SYMBOL) as symbols
  FROM variants, UNNEST(alternate_bases) ab, UNNEST(ab.vep) v
  WHERE v.SYMBOL IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants) as num_variants,
  (SELECT SUM(AN) FROM variants) as total_allele_count,
  (SELECT SUM(ab.AC) FROM variants, UNNEST(variants.alternate_bases) ab) as total_alternate_allele_count,
  (SELECT STRING_AGG(symbol, ', ' ORDER BY symbol) FROM gene_symbols, UNNEST(symbols) symbol) as gene_symbols,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(55064852 - 55039447, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants)) as mutation_density

WITH mitelman_gains AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(TotalCases AS INT64)) AS FLOAT64) as frequency
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401' AND Abnormality LIKE '+%'
  GROUP BY Chromosome
),
tcga_amplifications AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(TotalCases AS INT64)) AS FLOAT64) as frequency
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401' AND Type = 'U' AND (Abnormality LIKE 'dup%' OR Abnormality LIKE 'add%')
  GROUP BY Chromosome
),
mitelman_losses AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(TotalCases AS INT64)) AS FLOAT64) as frequency
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401' AND Abnormality LIKE '-%'
  GROUP BY Chromosome
),
tcga_deletions AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(TotalCases AS INT64)) AS FLOAT64) as frequency
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401' AND Type = 'U' AND Abnormality LIKE 'del%'
  GROUP BY Chromosome
),
gain_corr AS (
  SELECT 
    CORR(m.frequency, t.frequency) as r,
    COUNT(*) as n
  FROM mitelman_gains m
  LEFT JOIN tcga_amplifications t ON m.Chromosome = t.Chromosome
),
loss_corr AS (
  SELECT 
    CORR(m.frequency, t.frequency) as r,
    COUNT(*) as n
  FROM mitelman_losses m
  LEFT JOIN tcga_deletions t ON m.Chromosome = t.Chromosome
)
SELECT 
  'gain vs amplification' as aberration_type,
  r as pearson_correlation,
  n as n_records
FROM gain_corr
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'loss vs deletion' as aberration_type,
  r as pearson_correlation,
  n as n_records
FROM loss_corr

  UNION ALL SELECT 1998, avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q4` WHERE geoid = '42003'

question_with_answer AS (

WITH mapped_proteome AS (
  SELECT 
    p.gene_symbol,
    p.protein_abundance_log2ratio,
    m.sample_submitter_id,
    m.sample_type
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current` p
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.PDC_metadata.aliquot_to_case_mapping_current` m
    ON p.sample_id = m.sample_id
  WHERE m.sample_type IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
),
rna_expr AS (
  SELECT 
    gene_name,
    sample_barcode,
    sample_type_name,
    fpkm_unstranded,
    LOG(fpkm_unstranded + 1) AS log_fpkm_plus_1
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current`
  WHERE primary_site = 'Kidney'
    AND sample_type_name IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND fpkm_unstranded IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    mp.gene_symbol,
    mp.sample_type,
    mp.protein_abundance_log2ratio AS protein,
    re.log_fpkm_plus_1 AS rna
  FROM mapped_proteome mp
  JOIN rna_expr re
    ON mp.sample_submitter_id = re.sample_barcode
    AND mp.gene_symbol = re.gene_name
    AND mp.sample_type = re.sample_type_name
),
gene_corr AS (
  SELECT 
    sample_type,
    gene_symbol,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(*) * SUM(protein * rna) - SUM(protein) * SUM(rna),
      SQRT(
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(protein * protein) - SUM(protein) * SUM(protein)) *
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(rna * rna) - SUM(rna) * SUM(rna))
      )
    ) AS correlation
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY sample_type, gene_symbol
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
filtered_corr AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM gene_corr
  WHERE ABS(correlation) <= 0.5
)
SELECT 
  sample_type,
  AVG(correlation) AS avg_correlation,
  COUNT(*) AS num_genes
FROM filtered_corr
GROUP BY sample_type

WITH patient_mutation AS (
  SELECT 
    p.bcr_patient_barcode,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup` p
  LEFT JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` m
    ON p.bcr_patient_barcode = m.ParticipantBarcode 
    AND m.Study = 'PAAD'
  WHERE p.acronym = 'PAAD'
  GROUP BY p.bcr_patient_barcode
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as b,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as d
  FROM patient_mutation
)
SELECT 
  a, b, c, d,
  (a + b + c + d) as grand_total,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    POWER((a * (a + b + c + d)) - ((a + b) * (a + c)), 2) * (a + b + c + d),
    (a + b) * (c + d) * (a + c) * (b + d)
  ) as chi_squared
FROM contingency

-- Calculate net difference between PAAD patients with both KRAS and TP53 mutations (PASS) and those without mutations in either gene
SELECT 
  (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN ParticipantBarcode END) - 
   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN ParticipantBarcode END)) as net_difference
FROM (
  SELECT 
    ParticipantBarcode,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' AND FILTER = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' AND FILTER = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`

)

WITH cases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CaseNo
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
),
events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.CaseNo, cc.Chr, cc.Start, cc.End, cc.Type
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  JOIN cases c ON cc.CaseNo = c.CaseNo
),
band_events AS (
  SELECT 
    cb.cytoband_name,
    cb.chromosome,
    cb.hg38_start,
    cb.hg38_stop,
    e.CaseNo,
    e.Type
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb
  LEFT JOIN events e 
    ON e.Chr = cb.chromosome
    AND e.Start >= cb.hg38_start AND e.Start < cb.hg38_stop
),
agg AS (
  SELECT 
    cytoband_name,
    chromosome,
    hg38_start,
    hg38_stop,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Type = 'Gain' THEN CaseNo END) as amplifications,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Type = 'Gain' THEN CaseNo END) as gains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Type = 'Loss' THEN CaseNo END) as losses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Type = 'Loss' THEN CaseNo END) as homozygous_deletions
  FROM band_events
  GROUP BY cytoband_name, chromosome, hg38_start, hg38_stop
)
SELECT 
  cytoband_name,
  chromosome,
  hg38_start,
  hg38_stop,
  amplifications,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(amplifications * 100.0, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cases)), 2) as amplifications_freq,
  gains,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(gains * 100.0, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cases)), 2) as gains_freq,
  losses,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(losses * 100.0, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cases)), 2) as losses_freq,
  homozygous_deletions,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(homozygous_deletions * 100.0, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cases)), 2) as homozygous_deletions_freq
FROM agg
ORDER BY chromosome, hg38_start

WITH matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.RefNo, c.CaseNo, c.InvNo, c.Clone
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c
  INNER JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c2
    ON c.RefNo = c2.RefNo AND c.CaseNo = c2.CaseNo AND c.InvNo = c2.InvNo AND c.Clone = c2.Clone
  INNER JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c3
    ON c.RefNo = c3.RefNo AND c.CaseNo = c3.CaseNo AND c.InvNo = c3.InvNo AND c.Clone = c3.Clone
  WHERE 
    c.Chr = 'chr13' AND c.Type = 'Loss' AND c.Start <= 48481890 AND c.`End` >= 48303751
    AND c2.Chr = 'chr17' AND c2.Type = 'Loss' AND c2.Start <= 7687490 AND c2.`End` >= 7668421
    AND c3.Chr = 'chr11' AND c3.Type = 'Gain' AND c3.Start <= 108369102 AND c3.`End` >= 108223067
),
chr13_data AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 48481890 AND `End` >= 48303751
),
chr17_data AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 7687490 AND `End` >= 7668421
),
chr11_data AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) as rn
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain' AND Start <= 108369102 AND `End` >= 108223067
)
SELECT 
  mc.RefNo,
  mc.CaseNo,
  mc.InvNo,
  mc.Clone,
  c13.ChrOrd AS Chr13_ChrOrd, c13.Start AS Chr13_Start, c13.`End` AS Chr13_End,
  c17.ChrOrd AS Chr17_ChrOrd, c17.Start AS Chr17_Start, c17.`End` AS Chr17_End,
  c11.ChrOrd AS Chr11_ChrOrd, c11.Start AS Chr11_Start, c11.`End` AS Chr11_End,
  k.CloneShort
FROM matching_clones mc
LEFT JOIN chr13_data c13 ON mc.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13.Clone AND c13.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN chr17_data c17 ON mc.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17.Clone AND c17.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN chr11_data c11 ON mc.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11.Clone AND c11.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` k ON mc.RefNo = k.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = k.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = k.InvNo AND mc.Clone = k.CloneNo
ORDER BY mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone

WITH station_stats AS (

    COUNT(*) as total_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE stn != '999999'
  GROUP BY stn
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as qualifying_count 
  FROM station_stats 
  WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(valid_days, 365) >= 0.90
),
all_stations AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM station_stats
)

WITH subplot_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    c.inventory_year,

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE c.condition_status_code = 1
    AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    AND c.inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
    AND c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP'
    AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0
  GROUP BY c.inventory_year, c.state_code
),
macroplot_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    c.inventory_year,
    CAST(c.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
    AVG(p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot) as avg_macroplot_size
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE c.condition_status_code = 1
    AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    AND c.inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
    AND c.proportion_basis = 'MACR'
    AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0
  GROUP BY c.inventory_year, c.state_code
),
ranked_sub AS (
  SELECT 
    inventory_year,
    state_code,
    'subplot' as plot_type,
    avg_subplot_size as avg_size,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_subplot_size DESC) as rn
  FROM subplot_sizes
),
ranked_mac AS (
  SELECT 
    inventory_year,
    state_code,
    'macroplot' as plot_type,
    avg_macroplot_size as avg_size,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_macroplot_size DESC) as rn
  FROM macroplot_sizes
)
SELECT inventory_year, state_code, plot_type, avg_size
FROM ranked_sub
WHERE rn = 1

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`

),
classified AS (

WITH storm_obs AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, usa_latitude, usa_longitude,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(usa_r34_ne, 0),
      COALESCE(usa_r34_se, 0),
      COALESCE(usa_r34_sw, 0),
      COALESCE(usa_r34_nw, 0)
    ) as max_r34
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE basin = 'NA' AND name != 'NOT_NAMED' AND usa_wind >= 35

FROM us_ports p
JOIN storm_obs s ON ST_DWithin(
  p.port_geom,
  ST_GEOGPOINT(s.usa_longitude, s.usa_latitude),

WITH question_owners AS (

),
high_score_answerers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id as question_id, a.owner_user_id as user_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a 
    ON q.id = a.parent_id
  WHERE a.score > 5
),
percentage_answerers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id as question_id, a.owner_user_id as user_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a 
    ON q.id = a.parent_id
  JOIN (
    SELECT parent_id, SUM(score) as total_score
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
    GROUP BY parent_id
  ) totals ON q.id = totals.parent_id
  WHERE a.score > 0 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(a.score, totals.total_score) > 0.2
),
top3_answerers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id as question_id, a.owner_user_id as user_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN (
    SELECT parent_id, owner_user_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY score DESC) as rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  ) a ON q.id = a.parent_id AND a.rn <= 3
),
all_associations AS (
  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM question_owners
  UNION ALL
  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM accepted_answerers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM high_score_answerers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM percentage_answerers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT question_id, user_id FROM top3_answerers

distinct_associations AS (

user_question_views AS (

  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON da.question_id = q.id

user_views AS (

with_specialization AS (

WITH monthly_counts AS (

),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT
    company,
    month,
    trip_count,
    LAG(trip_count) OVER (PARTITION BY company ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_count,
    trip_count - LAG(trip_count) OVER (PARTITION BY company ORDER BY month) AS increase
  FROM monthly_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    company,
    increase,
    CAST(month AS STRING) AS month,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY increase DESC) AS rn
  FROM with_lag
  WHERE increase IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  company,
  increase,
  month
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3

WITH minute_quantiles AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT SAFE_CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) as trip_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds >= 60 AND trip_seconds <= 3000
),
minute_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_minutes,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY trip_minutes) as quantile_group
  FROM minute_quantiles
),
trip_with_group AS (
  SELECT 
    t.fare,
    mg.quantile_group
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips` t
  JOIN minute_groups mg ON SAFE_CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) = mg.trip_minutes
  WHERE t.trip_seconds >= 60 AND t.trip_seconds <= 3000
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    quantile_group,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(fare), COUNT(*)), 2) as avg_fare
  FROM trip_with_group
  GROUP BY quantile_group
),
group_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    quantile_group,
    MIN(trip_minutes) as min_min,
    MAX(trip_minutes) as max_min
  FROM minute_groups
  GROUP BY quantile_group
)
SELECT 
  gr.quantile_group,
  CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(gr.min_min AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm to ', LPAD(CAST(gr.max_min AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm') as time_range,
  gs.total_trips,
  FORMAT('%.2f', gs.avg_fare) as avg_fare
FROM group_stats gs
JOIN group_ranges gr ON gs.quantile_group = gr.quantile_group
ORDER BY gr.min_min

WITH label_counts AS (

  GROUP BY o.period, la.description
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.object_id) >= 500
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT period, label, art_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period ORDER BY art_count DESC, label ASC) AS rn
  FROM label_counts
)
SELECT period, label, art_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY period, rn

WITH new_user_initial AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitNumber,
    date,
    visitStartTime,
    totals.timeOnSite,
    totals.transactions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170430'
    AND totals.newVisits = 1
),
all_new_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM new_user_initial
),
initial_visits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitStartTime,
    date,
    timeOnSite,
    transactions
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      fullVisitorId,
      visitStartTime,
      date,
      timeOnSite,
      transactions,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY visitStartTime) as rn
    FROM new_user_initial
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
qualified_initial AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitStartTime
  FROM initial_visits
  WHERE timeOnSite > 300
),
purchase_check AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT qi.fullVisitorId
  FROM qualified_initial qi
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` gs
    ON qi.fullVisitorId = gs.fullVisitorId
    AND gs.visitStartTime > qi.visitStartTime
    AND gs.totals.transactions > 0
  WHERE gs._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT pc.fullVisitorId), COUNT(DISTINCT anu.fullVisitorId)) * 100 as percentage
FROM all_new_users anu
LEFT JOIN purchase_check pc ON anu.fullVisitorId = pc.fullVisitorId

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as num_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
    ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, s.station_geom)

),
incident_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as num_incidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_sfpd_incidents.sfpd_incidents` i
    ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(i.longitude, i.latitude))
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
)
SELECT 
  sc.neighborhood,
  sc.num_stations,
  ic.num_incidents
FROM station_counts sc
JOIN incident_counts ic ON sc.neighborhood = ic.neighborhood
ORDER BY sc.neighborhood

WITH months AS (

),
pm10 AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm10_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020 AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
pm25_frm AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS pm25_frm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_frm_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020 AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL

),
pm25_nonfrm AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS pm25_nonfrm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_nonfrm_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020 AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
voc AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS voc
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.voc_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020 AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
so2 AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 10 AS so2
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.so2_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020 AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
lead AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 100 AS lead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.lead_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020 AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)

SELECT 
  m.month,
  p10.pm10,
  p25f.pm25_frm,
  p25n.pm25_nonfrm,
  v.voc,
  s.so2,
  l.lead
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN pm10 p10 ON m.month = p10.month
LEFT JOIN pm25_frm p25f ON m.month = p25f.month
LEFT JOIN pm25_nonfrm p25n ON m.month = p25n.month
LEFT JOIN voc v ON m.month = v.month
LEFT JOIN so2 s ON m.month = s.month
LEFT JOIN lead l ON m.month = l.month
ORDER BY m.month

WITH living_patients AS (

patients_with_one_condition AS (

),
patient_conditions AS (

    pwc.patient_id,

    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM patients_with_one_condition pwc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c

),
patient_active_meds AS (

max_meds_per_condition AS (

)
SELECT 
  condition_display as condition_name,

SELECT

WHERE stn = '723758' AND mo = '10'

WITH user_months AS (
  SELECT `by` as user_id, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH) as activity_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.hacker_news.full`
  WHERE timestamp < TIMESTAMP('2024-09-10') AND `by` IS NOT NULL AND `by` != ''
  GROUP BY `by`, activity_month
),
user_spans AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(activity_month) as first_month, MAX(activity_month) as last_month,
         COUNT(*) as num_active_months
  FROM user_months
  GROUP BY user_id
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month, num_active_months,
         GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(first_month, last_month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) as month_array
  FROM user_spans
),
flattened AS (
  SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month, num_active_months,
         month as month_in_span,
         DATE_DIFF(month, first_month, MONTH) + 1 as month_number
  FROM all_months, UNNEST(month_array) as month
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT f.user_id, f.month_in_span, f.month_number
  FROM flattened f
  LEFT JOIN user_months u ON f.user_id = u.user_id AND f.month_in_span = u.activity_month
  WHERE u.activity_month IS NULL
),
max_gap_per_user AS (
  SELECT user_id, MAX(month_number) as max_gap_month
  FROM gaps
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT user_id, max_gap_month
FROM max_gap_per_user
ORDER BY max_gap_month DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_avgs AS (
  SELECT year, month, AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air, AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wb, AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dp, AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010` WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014 AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, AVG(air_temperature), AVG(wetbulb_temperature), AVG(dewpoint_temperature), AVG(sea_surface_temp)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011` WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014 AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, AVG(air_temperature), AVG(wetbulb_temperature), AVG(dewpoint_temperature), AVG(sea_surface_temp)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012` WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014 AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, AVG(air_temperature), AVG(wetbulb_temperature), AVG(dewpoint_temperature), AVG(sea_surface_temp)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013` WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014 AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, AVG(air_temperature), AVG(wetbulb_temperature), AVG(dewpoint_temperature), AVG(sea_surface_temp)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014` WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014 AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year, month
),
with_diffs AS (
  SELECT year, month,
    ABS(avg_air - avg_wb) + ABS(avg_air - avg_dp) + ABS(avg_air - avg_sst) + 
    ABS(avg_wb - avg_dp) + ABS(avg_wb - avg_sst) + ABS(avg_dp - avg_sst) AS sum_abs_diffs
  FROM monthly_avgs
)
SELECT year, month, sum_abs_diffs
FROM with_diffs
ORDER BY sum_abs_diffs ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(CoC_Number, 1, 2) as state_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Count_Year = 2015 THEN Unsheltered_Homeless ELSE 0 END) as count_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Count_Year = 2018 THEN Unsheltered_Homeless ELSE 0 END) as count_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_hud_pit_homelessness.hud_pit_by_coc`
  WHERE Count_Year IN (2015, 2018)
  GROUP BY state_code
),
pct_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    count_2015,
    count_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(count_2018 - count_2015, count_2015) * 100 as pct_change
  FROM state_counts
  WHERE count_2015 > 0
),
national_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct FROM pct_changes
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    p.state_code,
    ROUND(p.pct_change, 4) as pct_change,
    ROUND(n.avg_pct, 4) as national_avg_pct,
    ROUND(ABS(p.pct_change - n.avg_pct), 4) as abs_diff,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(p.pct_change - n.avg_pct) ASC) as rn
  FROM pct_changes p, national_avg n
)
SELECT state_code FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5

SELECT

  SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Clear' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clear_accidents,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Rain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
   SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Clear' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS diff
FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016`

  AND year_of_crash = 2016
  AND atmospheric_conditions_name IN ('Rain', 'Clear')
GROUP BY state_name

LIMIT 3

-- Step 1: Get channelGrouping + country transaction sums after dedup
-- Step 2: Filter to channelGroupings with more than 1 country
-- Step 3: Find the country with highest transactions per channelGrouping
WITH deduped AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    channelGrouping,
    geoNetwork_country,
    totals_transactions,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hits_time) as rn
  FROM `data-to-insights.ecommerce.rev_transactions`
),
deduped_unique AS (
  SELECT channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country, totals_transactions
  FROM deduped
  WHERE rn = 1
),
country_totals AS (
  SELECT channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country, SUM(totals_transactions) as total_transactions
  FROM deduped_unique
  GROUP BY channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country
),
multi_country_channels AS (
  SELECT channelGrouping
  FROM country_totals
  GROUP BY channelGrouping
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT geoNetwork_country) > 1
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    ct.channelGrouping,
    ct.geoNetwork_country,
    ct.total_transactions,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ct.channelGrouping ORDER BY ct.total_transactions DESC) as rn
  FROM country_totals ct
  INNER JOIN multi_country_channels mc ON ct.channelGrouping = mc.channelGrouping
)
SELECT channelGrouping, geoNetwork_country as country, total_transactions
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY channelGrouping

SELECT indicator_name, MAX(value) as highest_debt_value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_intl_debt.international_debt` WHERE country_name = 'Russian Federation' AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY indicator_name ORDER BY highest_debt_value DESC LIMIT 3

WITH high_income_countries AS (

birth_rates AS (

avg_birth_rates AS (

),
ranked AS (
  SELECT

-- Final result: top 3 lowest-level pathways with TAS evidence by chi-squared
WITH target_pes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe.stable_id as pe_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
  WHERE pe.uniprot_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
    WHERE i.drugID = 157
      AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
      AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
      AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
  )
),
all_tas_pe AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe_stable_id, pathway_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77`
  WHERE evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
lowest_pathways AS (
  SELECT stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77`
  WHERE lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_target_counts AS (
  SELECT ap.pathway_stable_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tp.pe_stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN ap.pe_stable_id END) as targets_in,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.pe_stable_id) as total_in_pathway
  FROM all_tas_pe ap
  LEFT JOIN target_pes tp ON ap.pe_stable_id = tp.pe_stable_id
  WHERE ap.pathway_stable_id IN (SELECT stable_id FROM lowest_pathways)
  GROUP BY ap.pathway_stable_id
),
total_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pe_stable_id FROM target_pes)) as total_targets,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pe_stable_id FROM all_tas_pe)) as total_all_pe
),
chi_sq AS (
  SELECT 
    ptc.pathway_stable_id,
    ptc.targets_in,
    ts.total_targets - ptc.targets_in as targets_out,
    ptc.total_in_pathway - ptc.targets_in as non_targets_in,
    (ts.total_all_pe - ts.total_targets) - (ptc.total_in_pathway - ptc.targets_in) as non_targets_out,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      ts.total_all_pe * POW(ptc.targets_in * ((ts.total_all_pe - ts.total_targets) - (ptc.total_in_pathway - ptc.targets_in)) - (ts.total_targets - ptc.targets_in) * (ptc.total_in_pathway - ptc.targets_in), 2),
      (ts.total_targets) * (ts.total_all_pe - ts.total_targets) * ptc.total_in_pathway * (ts.total_all_pe - ptc.total_in_pathway)
    ) as chi_squared
  FROM pathway_target_counts ptc
  CROSS JOIN total_stats ts
)
SELECT 
  cs.pathway_stable_id,
  p.name as pathway_name,
  cs.chi_squared,
  cs.targets_in as targets_in_pathway,
  cs.targets_out as targets_outside_pathway,
  cs.non_targets_in as non_targets_in_pathway,
  cs.non_targets_out as non_targets_outside_pathway
FROM chi_sq cs
JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON cs.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
ORDER BY cs.chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        a.assay_id,
        a.standard_type,
        a.molregno,
        a.activity_id,
        a.standard_value,
        a.standard_relation,
        a.pchembl_value,
        SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) as heavy_atoms,
        a.doc_id,
        cs.canonical_smiles,
        a.potential_duplicate
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp 
        ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs 
        ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
    WHERE SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
        AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
        AND a.standard_value != ''
        AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
        AND a.pchembl_value != ''
        AND SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
        AND a.standard_flag = '1'
        AND a.potential_duplicate = '0'
),
-- Activity count per (assay, standard_type, molregno) - must be < 5
act_counts AS (
    SELECT assay_id, standard_type, molregno, COUNT(*) as act_count
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
    HAVING act_count < 5
),
-- Duplicate count per (assay, standard_type, molregno) - must be < 2
dup_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        assay_id, standard_type, molregno,
        SUM(CASE WHEN potential_duplicate = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dup_count
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
    HAVING dup_count < 2
),
best_activity AS (
    SELECT 
        f.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.assay_id, f.standard_type, f.molregno ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(f.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) DESC) as rn
    FROM filtered f
    JOIN act_counts ac 
        ON f.assay_id = ac.assay_id 
        AND f.standard_type = ac.standard_type 
        AND f.molregno = ac.molregno
    JOIN dup_counts dc 
        ON f.assay_id = dc.assay_id 
        AND f.standard_type = dc.standard_type 
        AND f.molregno = dc.molregno
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT * FROM best_activity WHERE rn = 1
),
doc_base AS (
    SELECT 
        doc_id,
        journal,
        COALESCE(year, '1970') as year_key,
        SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64) as first_page_val
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
    WHERE year IS NOT NULL AND year != '' AND first_page IS NOT NULL AND first_page != ''
),
doc_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        doc_id,
        journal,
        year_key,
        first_page_val,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY journal, year_key ORDER BY first_page_val) as rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY journal, year_key) as grp_count
    FROM doc_base
),
doc_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        doc_id,
        CONCAT(
            CAST(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year_key AS INT64), 1970) AS STRING), '-', 
            LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(LEAST(12, FLOOR(CASE WHEN grp_count > 1 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(rn - 1, grp_count - 1) * 11 ELSE 0 END) + 1), 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-',
            LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(CASE WHEN grp_count > 1 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(rn - 1, grp_count - 1) * 308 ELSE 0 END) AS INT64), 28) + 1, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0')
        ) as pub_date
    FROM doc_ranked
),
assay_mol_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        q1.assay_id,
        q1.standard_type,
        q1.molregno as molregno_1,
        q1.activity_id as activity_id_1,
        q1.standard_value as standard_value_1,
        q1.standard_relation as standard_relation_1,
        q1.heavy_atoms as heavy_atoms_1,
        q1.doc_id as doc_id_1,
        q1.canonical_smiles as canonical_smiles_1,
        q2.molregno as molregno_2,
        q2.activity_id as activity_id_2,
        q2.standard_value as standard_value_2,
        q2.standard_relation as standard_relation_2,
        q2.heavy_atoms as heavy_atoms_2,
        q2.doc_id as doc_id_2,
        q2.canonical_smiles as canonical_smiles_2
    FROM qualifying q1
    JOIN qualifying q2
        ON q1.assay_id = q2.assay_id
        AND q1.standard_type = q2.standard_type
        AND q1.molregno < q2.molregno
),
with_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        amp.*,
        GREATEST(amp.heavy_atoms_1, amp.heavy_atoms_2) as max_heavy_atoms,
        GREATEST(amp.doc_id_1, amp.doc_id_2) as highest_doc_id,
        dd1.pub_date as pub_date_1,
        dd2.pub_date as pub_date_2,
        GREATEST(dd1.pub_date, dd2.pub_date) as latest_pub_date
    FROM assay_mol_pairs amp
    LEFT JOIN doc_dates dd1 ON amp.doc_id_1 = dd1.doc_id
    LEFT JOIN doc_dates dd2 ON amp.doc_id_2 = dd2.doc_id
),
with_classification AS (
    SELECT 
        wd.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN SAFE_CAST(wd.standard_value_1 AS FLOAT64) > SAFE_CAST(wd.standard_value_2 AS FLOAT64) THEN 'decrease'
            WHEN SAFE_CAST(wd.standard_value_1 AS FLOAT64) < SAFE_CAST(wd.standard_value_2 AS FLOAT64) THEN 'increase'
            ELSE 'no-change'
        END as change_classification
    FROM with_dates wd
),
with_uuids AS (
    SELECT 
        wc.*,
        to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(wc.activity_id_1, wc.canonical_smiles_1)))) as uuid_1,
        to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(wc.activity_id_2, wc.canonical_smiles_2)))) as uuid_2
    FROM with_classification wc
)
SELECT 
    assay_id,
    standard_type,
    molregno_1,
    molregno_2,
    activity_id_1,
    activity_id_2,
    standard_value_1,
    standard_value_2,
    max_heavy_atoms,
    highest_doc_id,
    latest_pub_date,
    change_classification,
    uuid_1,
    uuid_2
FROM with_uuids
ORDER BY assay_id, molregno_1, molregno_2

WITH scoring_events AS (
  SELECT 
    game_clock,
    period,
    elapsed_time_sec,
    team_name,
    team_market,
    points_scored,
    event_description,
    event_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, event_id) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE game_id = '95cda731-b593-42cd-8573-621a3d1369dc'
    AND points_scored > 0
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    s.game_clock,
    s.period,
    s.elapsed_time_sec,
    s.team_name,
    s.team_market,
    s.points_scored,
    s.event_description,
    s.event_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s2.team_market = 'Kentucky' THEN s2.points_scored ELSE 0 END) AS wildcats_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s2.team_market = 'Notre Dame' THEN s2.points_scored ELSE 0 END) AS fighting_irish_score
  FROM scoring_events s
  JOIN scoring_events s2 ON s2.rn <= s.rn
  GROUP BY s.game_clock, s.period, s.elapsed_time_sec, s.team_name, s.team_market, s.points_scored, s.event_description, s.event_id, s.rn
)
SELECT 
  game_clock,
  CAST(period AS STRING) AS period,
  team_name,
  team_market,
  CAST(points_scored AS INT64) AS points_scored,
  event_description,
  CAST(wildcats_score AS INT64) AS wildcats_score,
  CAST(fighting_irish_score AS INT64) AS fighting_irish_score
FROM cumulative
ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, event_id

WITH user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', MIN(event_date)), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', MIN(event_date))) - 1) DAY) as cohort_monday
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181003'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
week2_date AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    cohort_monday,
    DATE_ADD(cohort_monday, INTERVAL 14 DAY) as week2_monday
  FROM user_cohort
),
week2_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) as session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181003'
)
SELECT 
  w2d.cohort_monday,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w2s.user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL THEN w2d.user_pseudo_id END), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) as week2_retention_rate
FROM week2_date w2d
LEFT JOIN week2_sessions w2s 
  ON w2d.user_pseudo_id = w2s.user_pseudo_id 
  AND w2s.session_date = w2d.week2_monday
WHERE w2d.cohort_monday >= '2018-07-09' AND w2d.cohort_monday <= '2018-09-17'
GROUP BY w2d.cohort_monday
ORDER BY w2d.cohort_monday

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) as rn
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180716'
    AND event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id, 
    first_quickplay_date, 
    initial_quickplay_type,
    CASE first_quickplay_date
      WHEN '20180702' THEN '20180716'
      WHEN '20180703' THEN '20180717'
      WHEN '20180704' THEN '20180718'
      WHEN '20180705' THEN '20180719'
      WHEN '20180706' THEN '20180720'
      WHEN '20180707' THEN '20180721'
      WHEN '20180708' THEN '20180722'
      WHEN '20180709' THEN '20180723'
      WHEN '20180710' THEN '20180724'
      WHEN '20180711' THEN '20180725'
      WHEN '20180712' THEN '20180726'
      WHEN '20180713' THEN '20180727'
      WHEN '20180714' THEN '20180728'
      WHEN '20180715' THEN '20180729'
      WHEN '20180716' THEN '20180730'
    END as return_date
  FROM user_first_qp
  WHERE rn = 1
),
user_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id, event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180716' AND '20180730'
)
SELECT 
  c.initial_quickplay_type,
  COUNT(*) as cohort_size,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ue.user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.user_pseudo_id END) as retained,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ue.user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.user_pseudo_id END),
    COUNT(*)
  ), 4) as retention_rate
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN user_events ue 
  ON c.user_pseudo_id = ue.user_pseudo_id 
  AND c.return_date = ue.event_date
GROUP BY c.initial_quickplay_type
ORDER BY c.initial_quickplay_type

WITH first_opens AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) as first_open_shanghai
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'first_open' 
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, first_open_shanghai
  FROM first_opens
  WHERE DATE(first_open_shanghai) BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-09-07'
),
user_retention AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF(DATE(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)), DATE(c.first_open_shanghai), DAY) BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF(DATE(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)), DATE(c.first_open_shanghai), DAY) BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF(DATE(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)), DATE(c.first_open_shanghai), DAY) BETWEEN 15 AND 21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week3
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
  WHERE TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR) > c.first_open_shanghai
    AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR) <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(c.first_open_shanghai, INTERVAL 21 DAY)
  GROUP BY c.user_pseudo_id
),
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM cohort
),
retention_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(week1) as week1_retained,
    SUM(week2) as week2_retained,
    SUM(week3) as week3_retained
  FROM user_retention
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(r.week1_retained, cs.total) as week_1_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(r.week2_retained, cs.total) as week_2_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(r.week3_retained, cs.total) as week_3_retention_rate
FROM retention_counts r
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs

-- Final query: percentage of users who first opened in Sept 2018 and uninstalled within 7 days, that experienced a crash
WITH first_opens AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(CAST(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp) AS DATE)) AS first_open_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_201809*`
  WHERE event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
uninstallers AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(CAST(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp) AS DATE)) AS uninstall_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_201809*`
  WHERE event_name = 'app_remove'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
qualifying_users AS (
  SELECT 
    fo.user_pseudo_id
  FROM first_opens fo
  JOIN uninstallers u ON fo.user_pseudo_id = u.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE DATE_DIFF(u.uninstall_date, fo.first_open_date, DAY) <= 7
    AND DATE_DIFF(u.uninstall_date, fo.first_open_date, DAY) >= 0
),
crashers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_201809*`
  WHERE event_name = 'app_exception'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_pseudo_id), COUNT(DISTINCT q.user_pseudo_id)) * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM qualifying_users q
LEFT JOIN crashers c ON q.user_pseudo_id = c.user_pseudo_id

-- Final verification: check cohort size and total retained users across all weeks
WITH cohort_users AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_date) as first_event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181002'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING MIN(event_date) BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180708'
),
cohort_first_week AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_event_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_event_date)) - 2) DAY) as cohort_monday
  FROM cohort_users
),
user_events AS (
  SELECT 
    cu.user_pseudo_id,
    e.event_date,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date)) - 2) DAY) as event_monday
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
  JOIN cohort_first_week cu ON e.user_pseudo_id = cu.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181002'
),
user_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_monday,
    DATE_DIFF(event_monday, cohort_monday, WEEK) as week_offset
  FROM user_events
  JOIN cohort_first_week USING (user_pseudo_id)
),
retention_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    week_offset,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) as retained_users
  FROM user_weeks
  WHERE week_offset BETWEEN 0 AND 4
  GROUP BY week_offset
),
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as new_users FROM cohort_users
)
SELECT 
  CONCAT('Week ', CAST(r.week_offset AS STRING)) as week_identifier,
  c.new_users as total_new_users,
  r.retained_users
FROM retention_counts r
CROSS JOIN cohort_size c
ORDER BY r.week_offset

-- Final query: Get the Monday date of the cohort with the highest 4th-week retention rate
WITH user_first_session AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) AS first_session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) >= DATE '2018-07-02'
),
user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_date,
    DATE_SUB(first_session_date, INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM first_session_date) - 2) DAY) AS cohort_monday
  FROM user_first_session
),
user_session_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
),
user_session_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    usd.user_pseudo_id,
    usd.session_date,
    DATE_SUB(usd.session_date, INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM usd.session_date) - 2) DAY) AS session_week_monday
  FROM user_session_dates usd
),
cohort_retention AS (
  SELECT 
    uc.cohort_monday,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN usw.session_week_monday = DATE_ADD(uc.cohort_monday, INTERVAL 4 WEEK)
        THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      END),
      COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_pseudo_id)
    ) AS retention_rate_4th_week
  FROM user_cohort uc
  LEFT JOIN user_session_weeks usw
    ON uc.user_pseudo_id = usw.user_pseudo_id
  GROUP BY uc.cohort_monday
)
SELECT cohort_monday
FROM cohort_retention
ORDER BY retention_rate_4th_week DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH page_view_events AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102` e,
  UNNEST(e.event_params) as ep_session,
  UNNEST(e.event_params) as ep_page
  WHERE e.event_name = 'page_view'
    AND ep_session.key = 'ga_session_id'
    AND ep_page.key = 'page_title'
    AND ep_page.value.string_value IS NOT NULL
),
session_pages AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN page_title = 'Home' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_home,
    MAX(CASE WHEN page_title = 'Checkout Confirmation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_checkout
  FROM page_view_events
  GROUP BY session_id
)

  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_home = 1 AND has_checkout = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(has_home)) * 100 as conversion_rate
FROM session_pages

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') as page_title,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') as page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`
  WHERE user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
segments AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    page_location,
    seg,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_timestamp ORDER BY ordinality) as rn
  FROM page_views,
  UNNEST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) AS seg WITH OFFSET AS ordinality
  WHERE seg != ''
),
seg4 AS (
  SELECT event_timestamp, seg as seg4 FROM segments WHERE rn = 4
),
seg5 AS (
  SELECT event_timestamp, seg as seg5 FROM segments WHERE rn = 5
),
seg_last AS (
  SELECT event_timestamp, seg as last_seg FROM segments
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_timestamp ORDER BY rn DESC) = 1
),
seg_count AS (
  SELECT event_timestamp, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM segments GROUP BY event_timestamp
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    pv.event_timestamp,
    pv.page_title,
    pv.page_location,
    CASE

          OR LOWER(REPLACE(s4.seg4, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%wearables%'
          OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%accessories%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%apparel%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%brands%'
          OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%campus collection%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%drinkware%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%electronics%'
          OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%google redesign%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%lifestyle%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%nest%'
          OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%new 2015 logo%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%notebooks journals%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%office%'
          OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%shop by brand%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%small goods%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%stationery%'
          OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%wearables%'
        )
      THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN sc.cnt >= 5
        AND LOWER(sl.last_seg) NOT LIKE '%+%'
        AND (s4.seg4 IS NULL OR LOWER(s4.seg4) NOT LIKE '%+%')
        AND (
          LOWER(REPLACE(s4.seg4, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%accessories%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s4.seg4, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%apparel%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s4.seg4, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%brands%'

          OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%campus collection%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%drinkware%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%electronics%'
          OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%google redesign%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%lifestyle%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%nest%'
          OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%new 2015 logo%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%notebooks journals%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%office%'
          OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%shop by brand%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%small goods%' OR LOWER(REPLACE(s5.seg5, '+', ' ')) LIKE '%stationery%'

  LEFT JOIN seg5 s5 ON pv.event_timestamp = s5.event_timestamp
  LEFT JOIN seg_last sl ON pv.event_timestamp = sl.event_timestamp
  LEFT JOIN seg_count sc ON pv.event_timestamp = sc.event_timestamp
),
with_row_num AS (

    display_title,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) as rn

),
with_prev AS (

),
filtered AS (

)
